content: {"phoneNote": "The hero section hits the right urgent tone for an emergency locksmith, though the 'Navodila za pot' link is repeated three times in the top third of the page.", "desktopNote": "The hero works well, but the single-column sections ('Kje delam' and 'Kako poteka delo') leave massive, awkward empty white spaces on the right side of the screen.", "phone": {"impression": 4, "hierarchy": 4, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 4, "clutter": 3, "distinctiveness": 4}, "desktop": {"impression": 3, "hierarchy": 4, "imagery": 4, "spacing": 3, "clutter": 4, "distinctiveness": 4}, "fixes": ["Remove the redundant 'Navodila za pot' link from the hero section and the mobile sub-header, keeping it only in the blue address bar and main desktop navigation.", "Use a two-column layout on desktop for 'Kje delam' and 'Kako poteka delo' (e.g., section heading on the left, content on the right) to eliminate the large empty space on the right.", "Style the hero phone number as a clear, high-contrast button or interactive badge so visitors immediately know they can tap to call."], "blockers": []}
